item.title: New Tool That Turns Story Points Into Real Time Estimates
item.description: I got tired of guessing sprint timelines and want to help managers be confident of what their team can accomplish. So I’m building a tool that turns story points into real-time estimates. Velocity is fine if your team has the same type and difficulty of work, but this tool can help managers predict far into the future (WITH CONFIDENCE) what they can get done. I'm excited to be working on this and love others thoughts. Early access here: [https://planaia.carrd.co/](https://planaia.carrd.co/)
